1_characters.name: Gruff — Real Tangled Copper Electrical Wire & Romex Valve-Amp Bass (Redesign)
1_characters.ingredientNote: DO NOT attach old purple-yarn gruff-rest.png as an ingredient or purple yarn will bleed into generation. Attach LOC-01 only as lighting/material scale anchor.
1_characters.prompt: Full-body stop-motion miniature found-object puppet portrait of Gruff, the gentle Studio 404 bass singer, standing center-frame in three-quarter front view on a solid flat chroma-green background (#00FF00) under soft 2900K studio lighting. His head and upper chest are a battered, rusted vintage steel-and-wood vacuum-tube guitar amplifier chassis with two warm sleepy amber dial-lamp eyes, a wide expressive mouth formed in the frayed brown burlap speaker grille, a glowing row of six glass vacuum tubes along his brow (one tube glowing brightest warm orange, two dim), and a worn leather top carrying handle. Instead of yarn or fabric fur, his entire shaggy bulky coat, shoulders, and torso are built from REAL tangled electrical hardware: loops of bare stranded copper wire, stripped red/black/green PVC-insulated 12-AWG solid-core hookup wires, flat yellow and white 12/2 Romex NM-B sheathed electrical cable, colorful orange and red ribbed plastic twist-on wire nuts joining wire ends, and heavy black rubber 3-prong NEMA AC plugs sticking up like two asymmetrical horns (one slightly bent) plus a trailing frayed AC cord tail. Chunky 4-fingered oatmeal wool-felt hands and wide stitched oatmeal felt feet, with one small rainbow ribbon-cable patch borrowed from Tabby stitched on his right upper arm. Tactile macro stop-motion craft realism: real copper metallic glint, stiff PVC insulation, scuffed steel patina, coarse burlap, and hand-stitched wool felt. Generous clear margins around silhouette. Negative constraints: zero purple yarn, zero wool sweater loops, zero plush fur, no text, no logos, no shadows on chroma background.

1_characters.prompt: Meet Click, the brand-new Studio 404 Workshop Band drummer Moppet, matching the tactile stop-motion craft scale and lighting of Thrum and Clacker. Click's upright head and torso are a scuffed pyramidal mahogany-and-brushed-brass vintage mechanical studio metronome with a swinging brass pendulum weight across his chest, two warm glowing amber neon-bulb pilot-light eyes, a cheerful stitched felt smile, dusty charcoal corduroy sleeves with 4-fingered oatmeal wool-felt hands holding miniature wooden timpani mallets, and a borrowed strip of silver gaffer tape from Cue. Full character + compact front drum kit visible with generous clear margins on a solid flat chroma-green background (#00FF00). Negative constraints: no coffee tin, no pencils, never hitting own head, no readable brand text, no logos.
